Sean / Marissa —

Confirming we can put together the requested artifacts. Status and notes below (safe for external sharing unless noted):

1) CAIQ slice (attached): redwood_ca iq_slice_v2.pdf — condensed to Hosting/Network/KMS controls and mapped to our SOC 2 test coverage. We call out controls where we rely on a cloud provider (explicitly noted).

2) SOC 2 summary: soc2_control_mapping.xlsx (attached) — includes in-scope control IDs, assertion level, and whether testing is performed by Redwood or a vendor. We include the latest report date and auditor.

3) VPC diagram: privatelink_vpc_diagram_v3.png (attached) — shows EU-only tenant subnets, PrivateLink endpoints, and how egress to non-EU is prevented via routing policies and NAT gateway restrictions. Note: internal non-export routes (for backups/monitoring) are highlighted and have a documented exception flow; we're including the exception approvals.

4) KMS / keystore partitioning: operator_roster_2026-07.csv + an explanatory note in the CAIQ slice. We use per-tenant envelope keys backed by region-scoped KMS keys. Operator access is role-based with MFA, limited to named on-call and key-rotation roles. We will redact personal emails in the external packet and include role and team contact instead.

5) DPA / redlines: Marissa — we reviewed HealthBridge's standard DPA. The only operational ask to flag: a 30-day deletion SLA for ephemeral logs that reference customer ids — we typically provide a 45-day SLA in a hosted model (we can propose a 30/45 hybrid). I'll draft suggested language and attach a DocuSign-ready DPA.

Delivery plan:
- Monday 18:00 PST: shared Drive link to compact packet (CAIQ slice, SOC 2 mapping, VPC diagram, KMS note).
- Tuesday 16:00 PST: finalized packet with sanitized operator roster and DPA (DocuSign) link.

Risks / notes: if HealthBridge requires absolute zero cross-border backup egress from non-prod, we need to confirm whether they can accept a documented exception workflow for monitoring traces (these are redacted and encrypted in transit).

If Sean / Marissa approve, I'll upload and send the Drive link to Anika Monday morning (we can also pre-populate the DocuSign envelope).

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
